f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: ブレーキペダルを突然強く踏まず、圧力を徐々に増やしながら制動する方法。急ブレーキによる体の衝撃や車体の前へのつり，减少を抑える。
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: ブレーキを一度に強く踏まず、圧力を少しずつ増やして止めること。

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: 제동 페달을 한 번에 세게 밟지 않고 압력을 steadily 높여 차체를 부드럽게 멈추는 방식. 급제동이나 승차감 감소에 도움이 된다.
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: 한 번에 세게 밟지 않고 페달 압력을 점차 높이는 제동 방식.

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: Aplicação progressiva do freio,increasing a pressão aos poucos para deixar a parada mais suave. Ela ajuda a evitar travamento das rodas e improve o controle do veículo.
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: Frenagem feita com aumento gradual da pressão no pedal, em vez de uma aplicação súbita.

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: Cara pengereman dengan menambah tekanan pedal rem secara bertahap secara terus-menerus. Cara ini membuat kendaraan berhenti lebih halus.
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: Pengereman dengan tekanan yang terus meningkat, bukan sekali tekan mendadak.

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: วิธีเพิ่มแรงเบรกอย่างต่อเนื่องเพื่อให้รถหยุดได้อย่างนุ่มนวล แทนการกดเบรกแรงทันทีซึ่งอาจทำให้รถไถลหรือล้อล็อก
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: การเหยียบเบรกด้วยแรงที่ค่อยเป็นค่อยไปแทนการกดรวดเดียว

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.definition: Fren pedalına basıncın aşamalı olarak artırılmasıdır. Ani ve sert bir frenleme yerine daha yumuşak bir duruş sağlar.
f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.gloss: Fren pedalına bir anda bastırmak yerine basıncı kademeli artırmak.

f836d7203c7d0cedb1a5558596472d6a7424eb8c.translation: Yoğun trafikte kademeli frenledi ve araç yumuşak biçimde durdu.
ในการจราจรหนาแน่น เธอใช้การเหยียบเบรกแบบค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ทำให้รถหยุดได้อย่างนุ่มนวล
Dalam lalu lintas padat, ia menggunakan pengereman progresif sehingga berhenti dengan halus.
No trânsito intenso, ela usou frenagem progressiva e a parada foi suave.
교통이 혼잡할 때 점진 제동을 사용하여 매끄럽게 멈췄다.
渋滞中は渐进的なブレーキを使い、isser stoppingが滑らかになった。

f881477da62497690a4fee3f6ae2e0f63ca69183.text: They wanted a small fee before the equipment arrived, and then a larger one.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: Income measured in the money actually received, with no adjustment for changes in prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: Income measured in the money actually received, with no adjustment for changes in prices.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: 実際に受け取った金額で測った所得で、物価の変化による調整は行いません。
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: 価格変動を補正しない名目上の所得。

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: 물가 상승이나 하락을 고려하지 않고 받는 돈을 기준으로 계산한 수입으로, 실제 구매력을 나타내지는 않는다.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: 가격 변화를 반영하지 않고 실제로 받는 금액으로 계산한 수입.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: Renda nominal é o income nominal antes de qualquer ajuste pelo aumento dos preços. Por isso, ela pode crescer enquanto o poder de compra diminui.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: Renda medida pelo valor efetivamente recebido, sem correção pela inflação.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: Penghasilan sebelum disesuaikan dengan perubahan harga barang dan jasa. Kenaikannya tidak selalu berarti daya beli meningkat.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: Penghasilan yang diukur menurut jumlah uang yang benar-benar diterima.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: รายได้ที่แสดงเป็นจำนวนเงินโดยไม่หักผลกระทบจากการเปลี่ยนแปลงของราคา เมื่อราคาสูงขึ้น ตัวเลขรายได้อาจเพิ่มขึ้นแต่กำลังซื้อกลับลดลง
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: รายได้ที่วัดจากจำนวนเงินที่ได้รับจริงโดยไม่ปรับตามการเปลี่ยนแปลงของราคา

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.definition: Kişinin fiyat değişimlerine göre düzeltme yapılmadan elde ettiği gelir olarak ifade edilir. Bu tutarın satın alma gücünün değişip değişmediği hesaba katılmaz.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.gloss: Fiyat değişimlerine göre düzeltilmeden, gerçekte alınan para olarak ölçülen gelirdir.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.translation: Nominal gelirim arttı, ancak fiyatlar daha da hızlı yükseldi.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.translation: รายได้ตามตัวเลขของฉันเพิ่มขึ้น แต่เพิ่มขึ้นช้ากว่าราคา

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.translation: Penghasilan nominal saya naik, tetapi tidak secepat kenaikan harga barang.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.translation: Minha renda nominal aumentou, mas não na mesma proporção que os preços.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.translation: 제 명목 소득은 올랐지만 물가보다 천천히 상승했습니다.

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.translation: 私の名目所得は上がりましたが、物価ほどには上がりませんでした。

f8c58a360d060ec2a62bdd26c990cf19c184e3c3.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: The point at which ovulation and menstruation stop.
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: The point at which ovulation and menstruation stop.

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: 卵巣が排卵 功能と月経を永久に失う、よりPreciselyな更年期のこと。年齢によって起こりますが DeterminesExactな日や年齢があるわけではありません。
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: 排卵と月経が止まる時のこと。

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: 난소의 배란 기능과 월경이 멈춘 상태를 뜻한다. 특정 날짜로 표시하기보다 몸의 생식 기능이 바뀌는 사건으로 이해한다.
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: 배란과 월경이 멈춘 상태를 가리키는 생물의학적 변화.

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: Menopause adalah fase biologis ketika ovulasi dan menstruasi berhenti. Prosesnya berlangsung bertahap dan tidak dapat ditentukan tepat dari satu tanggal.
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: Titik ketika ovulasi dan menstruasi berhenti.

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: เหตุการณ์ทางชีววิทยาที่รังไข่หยุดตกไข่และประจำเดือนหยุดเป็นผลถาวร เป็นกระบวนการทางร่างกาย ไม่ใช่วันที่แน่นอนตามปฏิทิน
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: จุดที่การตกไข่และการมีประจำเดือนสิ้นสุดลง

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: Menopoz, ovülasyonun ve adet kanamasının kalıcı olarak sona erdiği biyolojik dönemdir. Belirli bir takvim tarihini değil, yaşamın bir aşamasını gösterir.
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: Ovülasyonun ve adet kanamasının bittiği biyolojik dönem.

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.definition: Fase da vida reprodutiva marcada pela cessation da menstruação e, em geral, da ovulação. Não corresponde a uma data específica, mas a um processo biológico gradual.
f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.gloss: Período em que a menstruação e a ovulação cessam.

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.translation: A menopausa é um evento biológico gradual, não uma data específica no calendário.
Menopoz bir takvim tarihi değil, biyolojik bir dönemdir.
แพทย์อธิบายว่าการหมดประจำเดือนเป็นเหตุการณ์ทางชีววิทยา ไม่ใช่วันที่ตายตัวในปฏิทิน
Menopause merupakan peristiwa biologis, bukan tanggal dalam kalender.
갱년기는 달력상의 하루가 아니라 생물의 변화다.
更年期はカレンダー上の日付ではなく、生物学的出来事です。

f8d94bd10c1b419aaf2a56cd784e4232d43878e4.text: Menopause is a biological event, not a date on a calendar.
